changedFiles.index.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><link rel="stylesheet" href="/src/tailwind.css"><link rel="stylesheet" href="/src/style.sass"><title>Ecosystem fixture</title></head>
<body><main>
  <article class="card hover:bg-[rgb(210,_220,_230)] p-[13px] text-[rgb(20,_30,_40)]" data-probe="card" data-identity="card">Card</article>
  <button class="action focus-visible:[outline-offset:3px] focus:[outline:2px_solid_rgb(30,_90,_150)]" data-identity="action">Toggle details</button>
  <section class="responsive w-[100px] width-gte-700px:w-[200px]" data-probe="responsive-layout" data-identity="responsive">Responsive</section>
</main></body></html>

source:
.card
  padding: 13px
  color: rgb(20, 30, 40)
.card:hover
  background-color: rgb(210, 220, 230)
.action:focus
  outline: 2px solid rgb(30, 90, 150)
.action:focus-visible
  outline-offset: 3px
.responsive
  width: 100px
@media (min-width: 700px)
  .responsive
    width: 200px
.retained
  display: block
